_comment: L1b retrieval-parity contract. Same utterance + registry -> the same selected tools IN THE SAME ORDER. Order is the load-bearing half: retrieval is scoring logic with tie-breaks, and the model sees the list in the order retrieval returns it. Consumed by python/core/tests/test_retrieval_parity.py and the `retrieval_parity_cases` test in native/crates/knaif-core/tests/parity.rs.
_expected_values: Produced by the reference runtime (Python knaif.registry.retrieve_tools). DO NOT regenerate to make a failing test pass.
_ordering: Python sorts (score, name) descending - so ties break on name DESCENDING - then appends the always-included control tools (clarify/reject/done) at the end. Both halves are part of the contract.

registries.demo:
convert_video:
  description: "Convert a video to a different container or codec."
  keywords: [convert, transcode, mp4, webm, convertir, 转换]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [container, output]
  arg_schemas:
    container: {type: enum, enum: [mp4, webm, mkv], help: "target container"}
compress_video:
  description: "Compress a video to a smaller file size."
  keywords: [compress, smaller, shrink, comprimir, 压缩]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [quality]
  arg_schemas:
    quality: {type: enum, enum: [low, high]}
trim_video:
  description: "Trim a video to a time range."
  keywords: [trim, cut, shorten]
  required_args: [inputs, start]
  optional_args: [end]
list_formats:
  description: "List the container formats this skill supports."
  keywords: [formats, list]
run_batch:
  description: "Internal batch executor."
  internal: true
  required_args: [commands]
clarify:
  description: "Ask the user one question."
  required_args: [question]
reject:
  description: "Refuse the request."
  required_args: [reason]
done:
  description: "Nothing to do."

cases.name: top_k_truncates
cases.query: convert or compress or trim this

cases.name: imperative_matches_infinitive_keyword
cases.why: 'comprime' is the imperative of the keyword 'comprimir' (a shared stem)

cases.name: word_extends_keyword
cases.why: 'compresse' is the keyword 'compress' plus a short ending

cases.name: short_word_is_no_stem
cases.why: 'conversation' shares only 'conv' with 'convert', and a keyword under 5 letters ('trim') takes no endings

cases.name: inflected_twins_count_once
cases.why: 'compress' matches 'compress' exactly, so the twins tool gets one keyword, not three; two_words matches two words

cases.name: best_twin_for_an_inflected_word
cases.why: 'compressons' is an inflection of all three twins; it counts once, through the keyword with the fewest claimants, ties on the keyword
